messages:
Yara D: Quick topic to lock down before the sprint cut: propose we convert sidebar groups into explicit top-level routes so shareable links look like `/p/:id/zone/<slug>/...`. Mock: https://figma.com/s/console-route-proposal. Thoughts?

Ben S: +1 on path-first. Cleaner for analytics and easier to feature-flag. Minor caveat: we need a rewrite plan for legacy `#zone=` links.

Lena M: Accessibility checklist: on direct deep-link we must 1) set focus to the page H1, 2) add `aria-current="page"` on the active nav item, 3) expose `role="navigation" aria-label="Primary navigation"`. Also ensure breadcrumb truncation exposes an accessible menu.

Omar R: Implementation idea: parser priority path -> query -> hash. If legacy query/hash detected, do a `history.replaceState` to the canonical `/p/:id/zone/:slug/*` and emit `nav.normalize` telemetry. Keep collapse state in sessionStorage.

a11y-bot: Reminder: when the breadcrumb overflow is used, the trigger must have `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded` updated; keyboard focus should move into the menu. Announce zone switches with a polite live region.

QA-Liz: Tests I'll add: deep-link focus, back/forward after replaceState, legacy-link normalization monitoring, breadcrumb overflow keyboard nav, and scroll position after deep-link.

Yara D: Copy: left nav full = "Model Registry", compact = "Registry". Root crumb should be "Projects". We'll avoid storing filters/collapse in canonical URLs. I'll update the figma and post final copy + canonical URL spec here. :sparkles:
